mu_name_from: MODEL_GUARDIAN_SHILED (MODEL_SHIELD + 20, MU's spelling), loaded from Item/Shield_21.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1119). Group 6 number 20 in OpenMU S6 Armors.cs:61.
why_this_one: The 100-140 gear MU has and this game lacked (the user, 2026-10-22: 'we need those low level items now', every class's but the Dark Lord's): the four second-class shields of Season 6's wave, beside the twelve weapons.
profile_from: The weapon profile, as every built shield uses.

stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateShield(number, slot, skill, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, defenseRate, durability, levelRequirement, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, energyRequirement, vitalityRequirement, leadershipRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel, magicGladiatorClassLevel, darkLordClassLevel, summonerClassLevel, ragefighterClassLevel); the group is slot + 5, 6.
stats.defense_rate_note: The shield's own block chance, which the fight does not roll yet. Recorded and unread.
stats.class_level_note: The Soul Master's alone: OpenMU's darkWizardClassLevel 2. sim::fits asks Wearer::second (docs/game/second-class-gear.md).

sheet_from: Data/Item: GDshield_a.OZJ (128x128, black plate with white curling scrollwork, mesh 0, 246 triangles) and GDshield_b.OZJ (128x128, violet crystal on grey, mesh 1, 66, the shards round the rim), decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
material_note: Black lacquer and painted crystal: painted_steel with the cast grain.
glow_note: RenderPartObjectBody's MODEL_GUARDIAN_SHILED arm (ZzzObject.cpp:7244-7248): the body solid, then mesh 1 (GDshield_b, the crystals) again RENDER_TEXTURE | RENDER_BRIGHT, added. Here the crystals solid and GDshield_b_glow, a copy of mesh 1's faces, added. PartObjectColor gives it Color 36 (ZzzObject.cpp:6684). Its other draws keep mesh 0 alone (:9120).
separate_meshes_why: GDshield_b_glow is mesh 1's own faces again; welded across meshes the two shells become duplicate faces and Blender keeps one (Wing05's trap, the Elemental Shield's WD_a_glow).
rig_note: Held, MuMain's arm is ZzzCharacter.cpp:8169-8191: violet (0.8, 0.3, 0.8) BITMAP_LIGHTs at 1.5 on bones 1-9, breathing |sin(WorldTime*0.001)| + 0.1 (fx/held_lights). export-rig --actions=all: ten bones, one action of one key; nothing moves, no rig kept.
